F1: BuildIndex` now takes the cache lock only when it stores the result (bleve.go:137-139), so two calls to the unsynchronized `getOrCreateIndex` can build the same key at once; the later build overwrites the earlier one and can drop updates a write event already made to it.
F2: the new `TotalDocs()` call at search.go:216 runs after the event goroutine starts, and `TotalDocs` reads `b.cache` with no lock while `BuildIndex` can write to it, a concurrent map read/write that crashes Go programs.
